notes: Last-updated time, slot count and course count moved from the bottom of the page into the sticky header, so data freshness is visible no matter how far you have scrolled.

One-off alerts now mute themselves automatically once their date has fully passed — and not a moment before. A same-day alert stays live all day, including late evening, and is only ever muted rather than deleted so you can re-date it.
Recurring alerts (day-of-week rules) are never auto-muted.
